items.name: Reveal
items.description: One hider's exact position live for 30s. All hiders notified on use.

items.name: Walky Talky
items.description: Push-to-talk private 1:1 channel with one chosen player; one speaker at a time (hold-to-talk). While active, the item itself shows as a red dot — no separate on-air indicator. Voice server (self-hosted) required, deferred.

items.name: Decoy
items.description: Fake hider marker spawned within a small radius of the hider; replays the hider's recent trail to look alive.

items.name: Drone
items.description: Arm a zone; any hider inside appears live (position + trail) for the duration, including late arrivals.

items.name: Found Clue
items.description: Shows one hider's position from 1 minute ago as a faded pin.

items.name: Radar Pulse
items.description: One-shot sweep: bearing + distance ring to the nearest hider. No pin.

items.name: Trapwire
items.description: Arm an invisible tripwire. A seeker crossing it notifies the hider and freezes that seeker for 30s (honor-system stand-still; their trail flatlines).

items.name: Clock +
items.description: Round extended by 3 minutes (endsAt += 180). Everyone notified.

items.name: Clock -
items.description: Round shortened by 2 minutes (endsAt -= 120). Everyone notified.

items.name: Proof of Life
items.description: Yes/no ping: is any hider within 150m? No coordinates.

items.name: Disturber
items.description: Hider emits a global jam: ALL seekers see nothing on the map (no pins, zones, trails) and cannot use items for 30s. Jammed seekers get a JAMMED banner + countdown (not a silently broken map). Does not stop physical catching.

decisions.hunt_visibility: no live hider data except within 50m eyes-radius of a seeker; anchor reveal once at hunt start
decisions.use_phase: items usable only after hunt starts; trapwire arms at hunt start
decisions.trapwire: arm at hunt start at own position, invisible, whole round, single trigger; seeker sees freeze banner + reason
decisions.pin_visibility: item pins visible to everyone from round start
decisions.pool: single mixed pool, role-lock at use time
decisions.clock: no total clamp; Clock- cannot end round instantly, hunt keeps >=60s
decisions.zone_lock: forgiving: 2 consecutive out-of-zone pings + 15m grace, soft-lock warning banner
decisions.own_trail: hiders see own trail dots, seekers see none (decided)
decisions.catch_loot: caught hider bank vanishes, no looting (decided)
